value.text: Using an Elemental Skill grants the equipping character "Laws of the Board," which increases their ATK by <color=#36ffff>20%/25%/30%/35%/40%</color> and their Elemental Mastery by <color=#36ffff>100/125/150/175/200</color> . This effect lasts 6s and can trigger once every 12s. Does not stack. The duration of this effect will also be extended by 6s if the equipping character hits an opponent with a Charged Attack while it is active. The effect can be extended for max 6s in this way.

customize.text: After unlocking Gnostic Hymn and reaching BP Level 30, you can select a weapon of your choice from the BP Bounty

customize.name: Heretic's Molten Blade
customize.desc: He drew this weapon once more when he first met that God of Flame, revered by all, but it had been too long since he had last used it.

customize.name: Forged by the Golden Melody
customize.desc: A greatsword decorated in gold. Legend has it that it was the favored weapon of a certain exalted Harmost back in the distant past.

customize.name: Frostbreath
customize.desc: A spear of solid ice imbued with an icy chill. It is said that it once belonged to the Belyi Tsar who ruled Snezhnaya in the distant past.

customize.name: Jade Vista
customize.desc: A longbow of immense strength. It shines with the radiance of dreams even in the darkest of nights.

desc.text:
It is said that in a faraway realm on the far side of the starry sea, or perhaps in an ancient era of which history and legend alike failed to record, there was a hidden world known to none.
As with all legends, this one began with a world that was formless and void, with neither beginning nor end. Only the three gods existed, passing the time amidst the infinite void in boredom.
The first god claimed the name "Valor," and he possessed unlimited power and divine might. None in the universe might best him in battle.
The second god was named "Cunning," possessing unlimited wisdom and guile. Since time immemorial, no one could see through his schemes and plots.
Perhaps personality differences were to blame, or perhaps they needed to pass the time, but these two gods would fight endlessly, having never stopped since the world's creation.
Yet, neither intelligence nor strength had any practical meaning in a world with neither beginning nor end, and such, too, proved the contest between the two gods.
Neither could achieve victory, but neither was willing to admit defeat. This, naturally, was when the third god, "Nature," finally spoke up with an interesting idea.
"Let us create a new world, upon which we shall use dice to determine the winner."
"For even gods cannot change the outcome of the dice."
Though no one knew what transpired in the middle, the three gods reached an agreement in the end and put their disputes aside to partake in this grand plan.
The God of Valor smoothed the lands and turned them into a square chessboard, and he made mountains and rivers in imitation of the past world.
The God of Cunning then carved chess pieces of various forms. Angels, humans, Jinn, monsters. He made the dragons and magical beasts also, those impelled by the God of Nature.
Thus were the heavens and earth opened, and thus did things come to pass.
Thousands of days and nights flew by. Countless adventures and legends took place in their turn upon this tiny, newly built world.
One thing, however, remained consistent — only the dice in the gods' hands could decide the fate of the world.
Even a seasoned Hero, though he could crush city halls of refined gold in but a single casual swing,
Was undone by the Dark Lord despite a valiant struggle, thanks to the vagaries of horrendous dice throws.
"Blast! Well, at least I came prepared for this eventuality. Valor's Hero comes equipped with divinely bestowed armor that has a mortal save. I shall revive the Hero and roll again..."
"Yes, but you'll have to pass a check before that. With the Hero in a weakened state, he is vulnerable to a spiritual attack from the magical sword that contains the soul of the previous Dark Lord..."
"Excuse me? Where is that coming from? I've never seen it in the rules, ever!"
"The Tome of Universal Laws, Page 83. You must have failed to read the updated version, I see."
"Damn you, Ibis, and your godforsaken, backstabbing ways!"
"Oh, come now, what are you saying? Deception is part of war... If you must lay blame anywhere, blame your failure to upgrade the Soul Barrier ability. Alright then. The Hero is now a piece on my side, and I'd quite like him to turn on his companions and..."
"Hold. The Hero is under the control of the previous Dark Lord's will. As such, he should technically not belong to the current Dark Lord's forces. Rather, he should be a monster under Nature's command..."
"What? What is this nonsense!?"
"Aha, you see? Now that the shoe's on the other foot, you've flown into a panic, too."
"With the Hero being seized by the previous Dark Lord, even the current Dark Lord was not his match. The ancient demons thus regained control of the world... The adventure ends here. Neither of you achieved victory, alas."
"That said, not all is lost. Let us create a new batch of adventurers and start another round... We have endless days and countless nights ahead of us, and shall naturally need adventures unnumbered to pass the time."

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.

Under the instructions of the First Sage, the ancestors of the forest people made these talismans using withered trees to commemorate the Lord of Verdure.

The talisman's shape was inspired by the forest dew. It symbolizes the permeation of wisdom into mortal minds.

materials.name: Damaged Prism
materials.desc:
A damaged component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.

These uniquely-shaped machines are the eternal sentinels of the desert ruins, and they possess the power to pierce the mountains and reshape rocks. The same principles that power many mysterious devices above and beneath the earth also power these machines.

materials.name: Faded Red Satin
materials.desc:
A piece of red satin used to cover the eyes. The fabric is slightly torn.

Many Eremites tend to cover their eyes with textiles, but the original intention of this practice has long been lost to the sands of time.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Iron Talisman of the Forest Dew
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.

Later, the Lord of Verdure taught people the mystery of the forging of black iron. The innocent mortals thus grasped the knowledge of using fire to forge blades.

The Lord of Verdure took pleasure in their knowledge - Lethal as fire and blades were to her, they made ordinary people powerful.

materials.name: Turbid Prism
materials.desc:
An old component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.

It is said that these machines are different from those ruin machines that come from deep within the desert, for they were not made as heralds of destruction or conquest.

materials.name: Trimmed Red Silk
materials.desc:
A piece of red silk trimmed with simple decorations.

A seasoned warrior can detect weaknesses from their foe's eyes and thus take advantage. The Eremites have long since lost a master to serve, and now they have no one to trust but themselves.

Word has it that they are more than convinced that all things betray, even their own eyes.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Silver Talisman of the Forest Dew
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.

In the myriad lore of the forest, the one in the striped cape that resembled blazing flames was the Greater Lord of the Labyrinths and the Owner of the Moon-Mirrored Spring.

When he bowed his head and struck up a friendship with the Lord of Verdure, the tokens of their friendship were the gems that glimmered like water and silver that gleamed like the moonlight.

To repay such a gesture, the Lord of Verdure promised to keep secrets for the Greater Lord of the Labyrinths and safeguard the intricate and beautiful dreams of the rainforest.

No one could have foretold that the magnificent mansion of secrets and dreams would later fade away amidst the shroud of the dark flame of oblivion, after which its ash returned to the soil and became nutrients for the virgin rainforests.

materials.name: Radiant Prism
materials.desc:
An exquisite component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.

The lord of the barren desert once had a dream, and once made a great many promises.

The legends of the desert say that these machines were originally vehicles for these unknown promises, which now live on only within their mechanical memory banks.

materials.name: Rich Red Brocade
materials.desc:
A piece of red brocade woven with golden thread.

Those born in the gilded desert under the sun occasionally sing a song, of which the meaning has been forgotten. They would praise the scorching sun that illuminates the earth as equally as ever and bewail the afterglow at the end of the dusk. Some unfamiliar words recur at the end of the song, which are said to be the names of ancient gods. Legend has it that when the King of the Desert was still alive, his people chose to cover their eyes as they dared not look upon him, whose brilliance was beyond that of the sun.

materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Golden Talisman of the Forest Dew
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.

"Mortals hold dear three things only: the spring water that embraces the moonlight, verdant life, and ageless youth..."

The nature of "wisdom" is not domination over all minds or scheming to gain all the benefit.

Instead, it is about empowering even ordinary beings to one day overcome their imposed constraints.

Though the roar of the tiger is no longer heard in the forest and the resilient guardians would seclude themselves within the dreams of children... On the night when every secret golden seal is lifted and all dreams glow like amber in the moonlight, perhaps she and her beloved people will eventually win genuine freedom.
